2317-5231-6664-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

1479-2783-2841-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2783-2841-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-4316-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4316-4871-5220.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1003-2997-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:

1003-2997-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3375-4200-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

413-5359-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Threefold Thunderhulk trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
When the Golems enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times. Resolve all Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1170-2440-4720-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-2440-4720-7577.description:
Cast the copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares enters, it and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Emeritus of Truce trigger, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Inkling creature token with flying and preparing Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C} since both Displacer Kitten and Stonework Beast share a creature type with Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares, exiling a creature an opponent controls and causing them to gain life.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat any number of times.

Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Avatar Kyoshi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Avatar Kyoshi's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Avatar Kyoshi's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5220-6766.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
When Haywire Mite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Haywire Mite.
Repeat.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1409-2653-5478-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Nissa triggers, adding {U}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
1409-2653-5478-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

When Golgari Thug dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to cast them this turn.
Cast Golgari Thug from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Mairsil using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.

Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Magus of the Candelabra.
2605-3525-4657.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
